description: Main backend API implementation for a mock car company service using FastAPI. Defines endpoints for health check, authentication, car catalog, services, parts, service centers, and user profile management, with mock in-memory data.

classes.name: AuthRequest
classes.description: Request model for authentication login, containing email and password.

classes.name: AuthResponse
classes.description: Response model for authentication, containing access token and token type.

classes.name: Car
classes.description: Model representing a car with id, name, type, year, price, is_new, and optional image.

classes.name: Service
classes.description: Model representing a car service with id, name, price, and duration.

classes.name: Part
classes.description: Model representing a spare part with id, name, sku, and price.

classes.name: ServiceCenter
classes.description: Model representing a service center with id, name, address, coordinates, and phone.

classes.name: Profile
classes.description: User profile model with email, name, bio, phone, and creation date.

classes.name: RegisterRequest
classes.description: Request model for user registration, including email, password, and name.

classes.name: RegisterResponse
classes.description: Response model for registration, including token info and user profile.

methods.name: get_current_user
methods.description: Extracts and validates mock token from Authorization header, returning user data.
